note: Completeness is computed from reporting statuses, never stored. Output per tier: universal gold/near_gold, study-type fraction, good_practice separate. No combined score. Tier membership pending the PhD lead.

computation.universal: Applicable items exclude status not_applicable and items whose not_applicable_for includes the study type. gold = all applicable items reported. near_gold = >=1 applicable item not_reported (missing list, plus not_checked list if any); missing takes precedence. unverified = none missing but >=1 could_not_check or not_yet_assessed (not_checked list with check_failure_reason). Location is never a pass condition (U1/TOP4). Paper is kept, never dropped.
computation.study_type: fraction reported / (items not not_applicable); not_yet_assessed and could_not_check are counted separately, not as misses
computation.good_practice: fraction reported, reported separately; never affects pass/fail
computation.required_secondary_tiers: (1) any required item not_reported -> near_gold. (2) else any required item could_not_check (or not_yet_assessed) -> unverified. (3) else secondary share: worst = reported / applicable (unchecked counted not reported; denominator = applicable items incl. unchecked); best = (reported + unchecked) / applicable. worst >= cutoff -> gold; best < cutoff -> near_gold (share too low); otherwise unverified. Output both shares and the missing / not_checked lists.
